children.game_version: A 'follow-the-leader' game mimicking the small kicks and hops.

seniors.counts: Use a 6-count rhythm to match the triple meter.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the 'cinq pas' rhythm with feet and hands while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the steps with support from a barre or chair, focusing on the rhythmic weight shift.

movement_profile.footwork: Cinq pas (five steps) involving small kicks (pied en l'air) and hops (petit saut).
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couple dance, moving through the space.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to the ground; jumps are small (saut moyen) rather than high.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, with weight evenly distributed between feet.

signature_moves.description: A five-step sequence consisting of two kicks, two hops, and a final jump.
signature_moves.name: Cinq pas

signature_moves.description: A small jump that transitions the dancer into the opposite posture.
signature_moves.name: Saut moyen

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: High, heavy leaps; the movement should remain 'bas et par terre'.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rapid and light, often consisting of four motifs of six pulses.
music_profile.sound_description: A brisk, triple-meter melody that feels lighter and more concise than the galliard, often featuring repetitive, danceable phrases.

basic_steps: Assume posture gauche (left foot forward, weight even).
Perform a pied en l'air droit (right foot kick) with a simultaneous petit saut (small hop) on the left foot.
Perform a pied en l'air gauche (left foot kick) with a simultaneous petit saut on the right foot.
Perform a saut moyen (small jump) to land in posture droit.
teaching.level_notes: Requires balance and agility; focus on keeping movements low to the ground.
